snippet.title: Tales of Tonbrook Trailer 1
snippet.description:
🎮 Tales of Tonbrook — Official Trailer 1 📜
Get ready to step into the enchanting world of Tales of Tonbrook, a cozy life-sim / RPG hybrid where adventure, friendship, and mystery await. In this trailer, you’ll catch glimpses of:

👉 Attending the Daverton Adventurer’s Academy
👉 Exploring diverse landscapes and hidden ruins
👉 Balancing school, missions, farming, fishing, and crafting
👉 Meeting a colorful cast of characters and forging relationships
👉 Tactical, party-based combat and deep lore awaits!

🆕 About Tales of Tonbrook
Tales of Tonbrook blends everyday life simulation with RPG mechanics. As a student at the Adventurer’s Academy, you’ll take on missions to pay your tuition, explore the realm, hone your skills, and create your own story. 
Steam Store
+1

🗓️ Release Info
Full release date: July 1, 2026 
Steam Store

In the meantime, a time-limited demo version is available!
